Food Safety
And Drug Administration Lko.

And Another .....Opposite Party(s) Counsel for Applicant(s) :
Alok Kumar Tiwari Counsel for Opposite Party(s) :
G.A. Hon'Ble Brij Raj Singh, J. 1.

Heard Sri Akhilesh Chandra Shukla, learned
counsel for the applicants, learned Aga and perused the record.

2. The present application has been filed seeking quashing of the summoning order dated 23.5.2024
passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shrawasti along with entire proceedings of Criminal Case
no.3631 of 2024 under Sections 18(a)(i), 16 and 27(d) of Drugs and Cosmetic Act, 1940, Police
Station Bhinga, District Shrawasti.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicants has assailed the impugned order on various grounds including the ground that the summoning order passed by the subordinate court is non speaking.

He has submitted that issuing summon is a serious matter in criminal case and the court has to open its mind and record its finding, but in the present case, a bare perusal of the summoning order shows that no such recourse has been adopted by the subordinate court.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants has relied upon the judgment of the Supreme Court in the case of M/s. J.M. Laboratories and others vs. State of Andhra Pradesh and another, 2025 INSC 127,
decided on 30.1.2025, which is also pertaining to Drugs and Cosmetic Act, 1940.

entities.text: M/s. J.M. Laboratories and others vs. State of Andhra Pradesh and another, 2025 INSC 127
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the aforesaid case, the Supreme Court has observed that lodging of criminal proceedings is a serious matter and while issuing summons, the Magistrate has to apply his mind, but in the present case, such recourse is lacking.
5. Learned AGA, on the other hand, could not dispute the fact that the summoning order is non speaking.

6. After going through the record, I find that the subordinate court has issued summons and has recorded the fact that it has seen the papers and there was sufficient ground to proceed and thereafter the court has issued summons.
The order passed by the court below is not reasonable and application of mind is quite lacking.
Certainly, summon of an accused in a criminal case is a serious matter and criminal law cannot be set into motion in routine manner.
As a matter of course, the court has to see the material on record and after discussing the same, summons could have been issued or the court could have dismissed the complaint.

sentences.text:
on 28 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43239785/
1 7.

In the present case, I find that the court below has not applied its mind and no reasons have been recorded, therefore, the impugned summoning order dated 23.5.2024 is set aside and the matter is remitted back to the court concerned to take a fresh decision in the matter within a period of six weeks from the date a certified copy of this order is placed before the court concerned.
8.
Needless to say that the order will be reasoned and speaking.
The applicants may take all available pleas before the court below, which will also be considered in accordance with law.
9. The application stands allowed.
(Brij Raj Singh,J.) October 28, 2025
